composition_summary: Offline full-v3 export only. The requested class-21 Recipe draft is emitted with the exact supplied constructor keys (name, description, trigger, steps, prior_knowledge_content, intent_examples, step_descriptions, variants, dependency_registry), trigger=null, steps=[], dependency_registry=null, one desc_idx=0 with a single persisted step using the knowledge/stepnumber/type=component/include schema and the two supplied UUIDs in order (ToolSkill 9fd5b0e0-2d93-5f5d-bb57-63d5c93061f7 then PythonCode ca75d647-4f0e-5a35-abe7-cee7353e03c2), tool_bindings=[], dependencies=null, one variant with step_link=0:1-0:E, variable_patterns=[], and ten distinct intent examples. The subworkflow posts exactly the fixed word 'Available' as a user reply via the bound existing host.post_reply Tool. This is an unapproved draft: it carries no version numbers or approval, and its dependencies (the existing post_reply Tool, its ToolSkill binding, and the class-22 PythonCode body) are unapproved and require Q1 and human Q2 before activation. The current offline sink cannot preserve the full v3 field set (it drops step_descriptions, variants and dependency_registry), so this export is a design artifact, not a live insert; no submission, activation or runtime/approval claims are made. The original conversation is preserved unchanged and the compatibility/intent/settings arrays remain empty under the test persona.
